{{Quote|That's the fifth groundquake since the Hutts' takeover. The last one leveled the Tigon mining colony. They're still pulling bodies from the rubble.|Shalim Avesta|<ref name="Trouble" />}}
The '''Tigon mining colony''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] settlement on the<ref name="Trouble" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Makeb system/Legends|Makeb system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Makeb]]. When the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] [[Conquest of Makeb|invaded]] Makeb<ref name="Trouble" /> in [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="TOR updates" /> they began massive mining operations on the planet, which triggered severe [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]].<ref name="Shelter">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Shelter from the Storm|Makeb}}</ref> The fourth of these groundquakes leveled the entirety of the Tigon mining [[Colonist/Legends|colony]], and bodies were still being removed from the rubble of the colony by the fifth groundquake. During the fifth groundquake, the [[Politics/Legends|politician]] [[Shalim Avesta]] discussed the Hutt Cartel's invasion with an individual affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. After the groundquake hit, he mentioned the destruction of the Tigon mining colony and subsequent rescue efforts to the Republic individual.<ref name="Trouble" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tigon mining colony was mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', a [[2013]] expansion to [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Trouble" />
